_readme: Facility-level accessibility records, keyed by station id. EMPTY ON PURPOSE: no verified lift/escalator/entrance data has been supplied, and none is invented. Add records only from a verified source, e.g. "MJST": {"confidence":"verified","lifts":true,"escalators":true,"stepFreeEntrance":true,"accessibleToilet":null,"tactilePaving":null,"audioAssistance":null,"source":"<url or note>","verifiedOn":"YYYY-MM-DD"}. null = unknown.
